This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine depicts two small figures boxing in a ring, overseen by a massive, partially visible figure. The background figure, shown from the chest down, wears a white collared shirt and has oversized red hands resting on the top ropes of a boxing ring. Below, two small male figures with simplified features face each other in fighting stances. Both wear black songkok caps, green blazers over white shirts, black trousers, and red boxing gloves. They stand on a blue surface within a ring defined by three red horizontal ropes.

White text at the top left reads "Meredam Dampak Inflasi Harga BBM H.82" and top right reads "Perdagangan Liar Satwa Papua H.72". The large white title "TEMPO" is centered, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Bottom-left text reads "BEREBUT PPP" followed by a paragraph starting "Konflik elite Partai Persatuan Pembangunan..." and ending "terlibat? H.32". The bottom contains a barcode, QR code, and publication details: "12-18 SEPTEMBER 2022", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
